purpose: Twenty-fifth-pass bounded parallel live official and first-party verification for four unresolved current-operation, regulated-service, tenant-identity and insolvency rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Primary auction pages, NHS, CQC, NHS DSP Toolkit, first-party operator pages, Companies House, Food Standards Agency and official council planning routes are promoted. Search-index or third-party planning summaries may identify a lead but do not replace direct official case readback.
method.conflict_policy: Conflicting current official signals are retained explicitly; closure, occupation, lease continuation, legal completion and parcel identity are never inferred.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: Millennium Medical Centre, 121 Weoley Castle Road, Birmingham, B29 5QD
rows.resolved_fact: The Acuitus record identifies the medical centre investment and a medical lease from November 2023. Current NHS, CQC and NHS DSP Toolkit routes all identify Millennium Medical Centre at the exact 121 Weoley Castle Road address. CQC still registers the location for regulated GP activities, the 2025-26 DSP assessment was published as standards met on 25 June 2026, an NHS stop-smoking service record at the same address was supplied on 29 June 2026, and an NHS recruitment advert was posted in March 2026. However, the current NHS GP profile explicitly says the GP surgery is closed. The property and organisational identity are strongly reconfirmed, but present GP patient-service status remains conflicted and is not promoted to open.

The Acuitus page names A Taste of Africa Limited as the 2025 commercial tenant under a twenty-year lease. Sugar Cane's current first-party pages continue to publish the exact 247/249 Lavender Hill address, live opening times, menus and booking routes. Several current first-party footers now identify SUGARCANE LTD, company 16165652, while the contact page still identifies TIKI VIBES LTD, company 15110665. Companies House records SUGARCANE LTD active at the exact address and a confirmation statement made on 6 January 2026. Current trading and the new exact-address company are strongly supported, but the relationship among A Taste of Africa Limited, SUGARCANE LTD and TIKI VIBES LTD, and their occupational rights under the auction lease, remains unread.
